snippet.title: Vaultbreakers - Reveal Trailer - Join the Playtest
snippet.description:
Closed Playtest Starts on January 31st. Get your key on https://vaultbreakers.com/
VAULTBREAKERS is a hardcore top-down PvPvE ARPG that blends epic brawler combat with tense, tactical extraction gameplay.
